currency.basis: Operating bank per Bank of Russia registry; the live site asset is the current presentation.

identity.basis: solid.ru is the official site of the Samara bank КБ «Солидарность» (reg. 554); the favicon and the header 'sign' group on the same page are the bank's own circular emblem.

assessment.independenceRationale: The official site asset and the CBR registry are independent; the header-lockup comparison was made on the same official homepage asset.

variant.basis: The standalone favicon variant of the circular mark, brand color #DB0334, matches the sign group of the official header lockup currently on the site.

candidate.detailsJudgement: The circular field, the diagonal slash and the lens-shaped counter survive optimization and rendering on both themes with the brand color #DB0334 unchanged; no lost detail or artifacts.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: The mark fills its square viewBox with even margins and stays recognizable at 24/32/48 px diagnostics on both themes; complete fit including the slash reaching the rim verified.
candidate.rationale: First addition for an existing record without an icon. The operating bank's official favicon is a genuine original vector and already the standalone circular emblem in brand color #DB0334, matching the 'sign' group of the official header lockup; no wordmark removal or backing change was needed.
candidate.role: Standalone circular bank emblem (circular field cut by a white slash and lens), served by the bank itself as its sitewide vector favicon.
transforms: No geometry, color or alpha edits: the working SVG is the byte-identical fetched favicon; no placement transform needed as the mark fills its 120x120 viewBox.

SVGO 4.1.0 with repository config svgo.config.mjs (sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e), multipass: 2601 -> 1518 bytes; selected (optimized.svg sha256 13b4a4e761c4779351b84d2ecbededaf86301dc4a1df86b371f2c0b89b6f1b7e) after working-versus-optimized render comparison showed only antialiasing rounding (5 pixels above diff threshold 8, max channel delta 64 on antialiased edges); viewport preserved.
candidate.variant: Original vector emblem on a transparent field; no circular catalog backing applied because the mark is itself circular and a suitable transparent standalone symbol; the white slash gaps are transparent, showing the theme background exactly as in the source.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: First addition: the frozen base has no icon.svg for this bank (iconHash null); the visible difference is absent-to-real-icon.

proposals.reason: Original vector found on the operating bank's official site: https://solid.ru/favicon.svg, the standalone circular 'sign' emblem of КБ «Солидарность» in brand color #DB0334, a 120x120 square vector served sitewide as the favicon and matching the 'sign' group of the official header lockup (i_logo_full inline SVG on the homepage, where the same mark precedes the СОЛИДАРНОСТЬ wordmark). The bank is active (Bank of Russia reg. 554); the 2023 revocation rumor refers to the unrelated Moscow namesake bank revoked 2017-12-15.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Genuine original vector served by the operating bank's official site; first addition for a record without an icon. The favicon is already the standalone emblem (no wordmark to remove).

sources.observation: Official homepage declares <link rel=icon type=image/svg+xml href=/favicon.svg> and carries the header lockup (inline SVG i_logo_full) whose 'sign' group is the same circular mark; the standalone favicon.svg (2601 bytes) draws the mark in brand red #DB0334 on a transparent field.
Bank of Russia registry: АО КБ «Солидарность» (Samara, reg. 554, OGRN 1026300001848) is operating; the Moscow namesake 'Солидарность' whose license was revoked 2017-12-15 is a different entity.
